explanation: Before cleaning your bare hand at 21.4 seconds, MRSA from bed rail A had a chain length of 4, 2 contaminated surfaces, 1 exposure to resident A, missed moments 1 and 5, and a score of 20. After cleaning your bare hand with alcohol rub at 21.4 seconds, the chain length was 3, 2 surfaces were still contaminated, resident A had no exposures, only moment 5 was still missed, the score was 8, and bare hand, gloved hand and resident A were kept clean.
